<div class="howto"><p><b>Today's move.</b> Thumb pushes beads up. Index finger pushes beads down. Clear the soroban after each number.</p><p><b>How.</b> Read the number. Set it on your soroban. A grown-up checks it and ticks the box.</p><p><b>Stuck?</b> A bead only counts when it touches the middle beam. The top bead is worth 5, each bottom bead is worth 1.</p></div>
